ownerVerification.reportedOutcome: The simplified Admin batch-creation flow worked successfully after the production fix.
verifiedBehaviour: Create Batch no longer reports the false BATCH_ALREADY_EXISTS error caused by the prior constraint-classification bug.
Student Login Manager remains a simple create-batch then create-student workflow.
No reactivation workflow is required for the normal Admin path.

rootCause: The initial batch INSERT omitted required created_at and updated_at values. D1 returned a constraint failure, and the old error handler incorrectly mapped generic constraint failures to BATCH_ALREADY_EXISTS.
permanentFix: Populate required created_at and updated_at values on new batch rows.
Classify only a true batch_key UNIQUE/primary-key collision as BATCH_ALREADY_EXISTS.
Keep Student Login Manager create-only: Create Batch -> refresh/select -> Create Student Login.
Keep visible spacing between the batch code and description in Copy settings from.
Production deploy workflow now includes and verifies Admin batch-creation code and route protection.
closure: The 2026-09-25 Admin batch-creation incident is closed as PASS with owner browser verification.
